confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Melbourne price levels; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Beer, cafe and restaurant anchors are moderately confident; accommodation is less certain given seasonal and property variation. Cocktail and wine anchors rely on general knowledge and were sense-checked against the local beer price relationship. Pubs, often called hotels in Australia, are treated as ordinary pubs rather than hotel bars. USD values use the latest RBA rate as a proxy for July 2026 exchange rates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other large Australian capitals such as Sydney, based on general knowledge of price levels. Accommodation reflects typical CBD and inner-suburb budget and three-star stock. No live listings were consulted.
